description: Deal playbook templates. When multiple signal types are present, the template with the highest priority wins. Edit these to match your actual messaging, case studies, and objection responses.

playbooks.title: New Executive Hire Playbook
playbooks.recommended_angle: New executives evaluate and reset the technology stack in their first 60-90 days. Position before they set the agenda.
playbooks.value_hook: Most new VPs inherit whatever's already in place. The ones who get ahead of it have better leverage over the stack decisions.

objections.objection: We just hired a new VP — too early to evaluate tools
objections.response: Exactly why now is the right time — before they're locked into existing vendors and have set their own agenda.
Transitions are when the best decisions get made. Happy to show how [Company X] navigated the same transition at your stage.

objections.objection: The new exec will have their own preferences
objections.response: Agreed — which is why a 15-min call now, before they're fully onboarded, is worth more than six months later.

playbooks.urgency_note: Action window closes when the new executive reaches day 90. Track their LinkedIn announcement for 'started new role' timing.

playbooks.title: Competitive Displacement Playbook
playbooks.recommended_angle: Target is evaluating or frustrated with a competitor. Lead with differentiation and switch incentive.
playbooks.message_tone: confident, specific, proof-heavy — never badmouth the competitor
playbooks.value_hook: Companies at your stage typically hit [specific limitation] with [competitor]. Worth 30 minutes to compare?

objections.objection: We're happy with our current vendor
objections.response: Understood. If you ever want a technical benchmark, I can share how companies at your scale have compared the two.
Fair concern. Our migration playbook covers this — [Company X] completed the switch in 3 weeks with no downtime.

playbooks.urgency_note: Move fast — competitive evaluations close quickly. Day 2 follow-up is intentional.

playbooks.title: Post-Funding Scale Playbook
playbooks.recommended_angle: Companies scaling post-funding face new infrastructure challenges. Your window is 90-120 days post-close.
playbooks.value_hook: Post-raise is when the infrastructure decisions that shape the next 2 years get made.

objections.objection: We just raised — not focused on tools yet
objections.response: Post-raise is exactly when infrastructure decisions set the trajectory. Most companies wish they had this conversation before they were 3x the size.

objections.objection: We have budget but no bandwidth
objections.response: Understood. This would be a 15-min conversation, not an evaluation. Happy to share what we've seen work at similar growth stages.

playbooks.urgency_note: Post-funding window closes at ~120 days as the company settles into execution mode.

playbooks.title: Product Launch Momentum Playbook
playbooks.recommended_angle: New product or major release signals a platform build-out is underway. Infrastructure investment follows launches.
playbooks.primary_cta: 15-min call — happy to share what works at this launch stage
playbooks.value_hook: Congrats on [product launch]. Companies at this stage often find [specific challenge] starts to surface at scale.

objections.objection: We're focused on the launch right now
objections.response: Totally understood — this is a 15-min call, not an evaluation. Happy to reconnect after the launch settles.

playbooks.urgency_note: Launch momentum fades in 30-45 days. Act while the company is in growth mode.

playbooks.title: Generic Monitoring Playbook
playbooks.recommended_angle: Monitor and build context. No strong buying signal yet — track for 2-3 more weeks before outreach.
playbooks.primary_cta: No CTA yet — build context first
